scenarios.name: ef-slider
scenarios.description: Slider contract on Exposure/Contrast/Clarity: soft pin, typing grammar, double-click resets, arrows, Escape, option-scroll, fine drag.

steps.note: drag far past the right end of the track
drag pins at the soft limit +5
typing 8 over a pre-selected readout gives 8 (no clear)
typed '* 2': * 2 clamps to the hard limit 10
double-click the Exposure track away from the thumb
one undo after a track double-click brings back exactly 2.00
single click on the Contrast label to focus the row
after Escape, arrows no longer nudge
scrub the Contrast number 20% of the row width

scenarios.name: ef-coalesce
scenarios.description: Undo granularity: one long drag with a pause, repeated drags 0.5/1.6/2.5 s apart, alternating sliders.

steps.note: one drag with a 1.5 s pause in the middle
one undo removes the whole long drag

scenarios.name: ef-undo-tools
scenarios.description: Undo/redo across WB, exposure, crop angle, linear mask, heal spot, rating, Auto Tone and Reset; recipe and sidecar after each.

scenarios.name: ef-history-snap

steps.note: scroll the develop column to the bottom
jump forward to the newest row
